findings.summary: A trailing shell newline defeats native-command detection, running the full suite and then failing preparation.
evidence: publish_release_common.py::run_pre_push_quality_gates uses shlex.split to recognize native_release, but appends modifiers to the original shell string.

For quality_command='./scripts/run-quality.sh --release\n', shlex.split returns the accepted native argv. Appending ' --release-prepare' produces a separate shell command after the newline: the full release lane executes first, then --release-prepare fails as a command.
The same input breaks final receipt collection when --receipt-json is appended. A trailing newline can occur in a YAML literal-block command.
test_only_native_prepare_defers_and_records_effective_command covers pipelines and && chains, but does not exercise newline preservation.
findings.action: Ensure recognition preserves shell command boundaries before appending arguments. Preserve unsupported shell forms unchanged through full fallback, and add a boundary test for a trailing-newline command and a newline-separated chain.
